Claude Code Skills & Plugins

 428 production-ready skills for Claude Code and 12 other coding agents, covering engineering, product, marketing, compliance, finance and the C-suite. We test whether each skill loads when you ask in plain words, and publish the results. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Works with: Claude Code · OpenAI Codex · Gemini CLI · OpenClaw · Hermes Agent[^hermes] · Mistral Vibe[^vibe] · Cursor · Aider · Windsurf · Kilo Code · OpenCode · Augment · Antigravity

 Install in one minute

 Claude Code 

 

 Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and other agents (the open-source skills installer)

 

More options for each tool are under Quick Install.

 Pick your role

 You are Install You get 
 --- --- --- 
 Software engineer engineering-skills Architecture, code review, TDD, frontend, backend, DevOps, security, QA 
 Platform or AI engineer engineering-advanced-skills Agent design, RAG, MCP servers, CI/CD, observability, SLOs, evals 
 Product manager product-skills Discovery, RICE, PRDs, user stories, roadmaps, UX research 
 Delivery lead or scrum master pm-skills Sprint health, Jira and Confluence, flow metrics, forecasts 
 Marketer marketing-skills SEO, answer-engine optimization, copywriting, CRO, email, paid ads 
 Founder or executive c-level-skills CEO, CTO, CFO, CMO, CRO and other advisors, board prep, hard calls

 Finance finance-skills DCF, budgets, SaaS metrics, month-end close 

Install with /plugin install @claude-code-skills .

 Start with these

Each of these loaded on every plain-language test prompt. See all verified skills.

 Skill What it does Install 
 --- --- --- 
 agent-run-forensics Checks what your agent actually did against what it said it did, from the session transcript agent-run-forensics 
 human-gate Refuses to ship a plan, spec or migration until a named person has reviewed it and no blocker is open human-gate 
 skill-retro Grades your skills from your own past sessions and proposes only the edits the evidence supports skill-retro 
 i18n-localization Finds missing keys, broken placeholders and wrong plural forms before a language ships i18n-localization 
 month-end-close Runs the close calendar, proves reconciliations and refuses boilerplate variance explanations month-end-close 
 cmmc-readiness Scores CMMC 2.0 Level 2 readiness, SPRS and POA&M close-out cmmc-readiness

[^hermes]: Hermes Agent is BYO-sync tier : the repo ships a pre-generated .hermes/skills/claude-skills/ tree, but you run python scripts/sync-hermes-skills.py once locally to install into /.hermes/skills/ . Uses the same agentskills.io SKILL.md standard — no format conversion.
[^vibe]: Mistral Vibe is also BYO-sync tier : the repo ships a pre-generated .vibe/skills/claude-skills/ tree, run ./scripts/vibe-install.sh once locally to install into /.vibe/skills/ . Same agentskills.io SKILL.md standard — no format conversion. Docs: .

---

 What Are Claude Code Skills & Agent Plugins?

Claude Code skills (also called agent skills or coding agent plugins) are modular instruction packages that give AI coding agents domain expertise they don't have out of the box. Each skill includes:

- SKILL.md — structured instructions, workflows, and decision frameworks
- Python tools — 824 CLI scripts (all stdlib-only, zero pip installs)
- Reference docs — 931 templates, checklists, and domain-specific knowledge files

 One repo, thirteen platforms. Works natively as Claude Code plugins, Codex agent skills, Gemini CLI skills, Hermes Agent skills, Mistral Vibe skills, and converts to more tools via scripts/convert.sh . All 861 Python tools run anywhere Python runs.

 Skills vs Agents vs Personas

 Skills Agents Personas 
 --- --- --- --- 
 Purpose How to execute a task What task to do Who is thinking 
 Scope Single domain Single domain Cross-domain 
 Voice Neutral Professional Personality-driven 
 Example "Follow these steps for SEO" "Run a security audit" "Think like a startup CTO" 

All three work together. See Orchestration for how to combine them.

---

 Quick Install

 Windows users: clone with git clone -c core.symlinks=true (Developer Mode enabled) — otherwise the .gemini/ / .codex/ / .vibe/ / .hermes/ mirror trees check out as 1-line pointer text files instead of skills — and set PYTHONUTF8=1 so tools that print Unicode don't crash on legacy-codepage consoles. Details: INSTALLATION.md → Windows Notes.

 Claude Code (Recommended)

 

Only names listed in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json can be installed. Most skills (for example skill-security-auditor or content-creator ) ship inside a domain bundle, so install the bundle that contains them. Run /plugin and open the marketplace to browse every installable name.

Claude Code

/plugin install engineering-skills@claude-code-skills

Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and other agents (the open-source skills installer)

npx skills add alirezarezvani/claude-skills

usage.title: Usage Examples
usage.html:
Architecture Review
Using the senior-architect skill, review our microservices architecture
and identify the top 3 scalability risks.
Content Creation
Using the content-creator skill, write a blog post about AI-augmented
development. Optimize for SEO targeting "Claude Code tutorial".
Compliance Audit
Using the mdr-745-specialist skill, review our technical documentation
for MDR Annex II compliance gaps.
